fields.label: Modèles
fields.quote: Across the two systematic reviews evaluated, Jev achieved high screening sensitivity at the prespecified cutoff, retained all reports included after full-text assessment, and cost less than the tested LLM configurations.

fields.label: Résultats
fields.value: Cutoff 22 % pour light‑therapy (spécificité 99,2 %, réduction 97,3 %) ; cutoff 14 % pour pharmacothérapie (spécificité 83,4 %, réduction 81,1 %).
fields.quote: highest cutoff retaining all human-retained light-therapy records in every run was 22%, with specificity of 99.2% and a reduction in review volume of 97.3%. For adjunctive pharmacotherapy, the corresponding cutoff was 14%, with specificity of 83.4% and a reduction in review volume of 81.1% (Table 2).

fields.label: Limites
fields.value: Limitation : les deux revues concernent le trouble bipolaire, ce qui limite la généralisabilité à d’autres domaines cliniques.
fields.quote: First, both reviews concerned bipolar disorder, limiting generalizability to other clinical areas.
